title: ce-work Return-to-Caller envelope
description: Machine-checked owner of the structured return ce-work emits in mode:return-to-caller, consumed by lfg's step-2 gate via `factory-gates.py validate`. Field meanings live in the ce-work SKILL.md Return contract; the lfg step-2 checklist remains the human-readable statement. Strictness policy: the top-level envelope and any sub-object whose fields the prose fully enumerates (implementation_engine_binding) carry additionalProperties: false; sub-objects the prose leaves open-ended (verification_evidence entries, unit_receipts entries, settled_decision_conflicts entries) are deliberately plain objects with no additionalProperties key, and verification_results is intentionally unconstrained.

plan_path.description: The plan path ce-work executed against.

verification_results.description: Verification command results; shape intentionally unconstrained (prose does not pin it).

items.description: Open object: the prose enumerates the facts each entry states (unit/task, behavior_changed, existing_tests_inspected, tests_added_or_changed, red/characterization evidence, verification run, exception reason) but not a closed field list.

implementation_engine_binding.description: Resolved one-run engine binding, or null when native execution was selected without a binding. When an object, exactly mode/target/model/source per references/execution-engines.md.

actual_model.description: Receipt-attributed served identity, or the literal string 'unverified'.

run_id.description: Durable external run identifier, or null for native execution.

items.description: Open object: route, model, detached-process, integration, verification, canonical-commit, and cleanup state per attempted unit; the prose does not pin a closed field list.

plan_checkpoint.description: Disclosed checkpoint commit when the selected plan was the only canonical dirt, otherwise null.

recovery_path.description: Preserved owner-checked run/workspace location when recovery remains, otherwise null.

items.description: Open object: names the labeled entry, the evidence, and how it was routed (proceeded-and-flagged vs blocker).

standalone_shipping_skipped.description: Always true in Return-to-Caller Mode; the mode marker the caller gates on.
